name: Buck Newton

items.why: This is a 2016 rally remark about HB2 and a political stance, so it is not conduct bearing on any criterion such as abuse of office, foreign ties, big money or lying about his record.

for_review: The HuffPost page could not be opened, so I relied on search-result snippets from CNBC, CBS/AP, Salon and others. They agree that Newton said 'keep our state straight' and later said it meant 'keep men out of the ladies' room'. The rainbow-flag quote appears in Salon, TPM and New Civil Rights Movement snippets. I did not open the full rally video or the News & Observer interview. The search on the owner's named sites (Alex Jones/Infowars, Stew Peters) found nothing about Newton. I didn't search Newton's records on money, foreign ties, business dealings or ethics complaints, so I found no separate against or open items. A reviewer may want to check those.
